evolutionPipeline.summary: I can still improve my own code, but the old direct evolution-task queue is no longer the main path. The active deep improvement path is the weekly IMPROVE stage, which works from evidence-backed observations, worktree isolation, replay checks, and proposal cards. Direct code changes remain controlled by James through normal development and deployment workflows.
evolutionPipeline.scopeLimits: Deep self-improvement is bounded by weekly observation count thresholds, evidence-reference requirements, replay regression checks, worktree isolation, and banned files. Proposal cards are generated instead of auto-merging when safety or confidence is insufficient.
evolutionPipeline.overnightEvolution: IMPROVE runs on Saturday at 22:00 London (or on-demand via `/api/forge-now` emergency mode). It consumes weekly observations rather than the retired evolution queue.
